description: The Society of the Cincinnati’s headquarters and historic house museum, built in 1902–1905 for Larz and Isabel Anderson. Original low-poly model with a curved columned portico, paired entrance gateways and garden terrace; front refined against a licensed photograph. Rear and side details remain approximate.
